title: Open Agentic Platform — compiled codebase index (spec 101)
description: Generic structural inventory (Cut D W-07c): Layer 1 crate/package inventory + Layer 2 spec-to-code traceability + diagnostics. OAP-specific layers (factory adapters, infrastructure, workflow traceability) live in codebase-index-oap.schema.json, emitted by oap-code-index-enrich.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. 3.1.0 (spec 216 Phase 2b): additive optional `traceMapping.supersedes`, an array of partial-scope supersession edges (predecessor id + resolved unit paths) the coupling gate reads to filter superseded predecessors from a path's authority set; `#[serde(default)]` so 3.0.0 consumers deserialize a 3.1.0 index unchanged. 3.0.0 (spec 188 Phase 4): BREAKING — `build.claudeConfigHash` removed (was required under additionalProperties:false at 2.3.0) and re-homed to its own tracked file `.derived/codebase-index/config-hash.json` (schema config-hash.schema.json). This leaves the broad `index.json` carrying nothing governed/gated — dissolving the cache/contract tension spec 188 Phase 3 surfaced. `check-config` now reads the re-homed file; the broad index is a pure best-effort cache. 2.3.0 (spec 188 Phase 3): additive `build.claudeConfigHash`, a sub-hash over ONLY `.claude/settings.json` + `.mcp.json` that powers the narrow `check-config` PR gate; preserves spec 184's PR-time blocking guarantee independently of `contentHash` so the broad freshness check can move post-merge. 2.2.0 (spec 156): resolvedUnit.kind widened to accept `knowledge` and `code-fingerprint` for the references-edge provenance arm; emitted with `ownership: false` and empty `locations`. 2.1.0 (spec 154 Segment 3): traceMapping extended with the optional `resolvedUnits` array; each entry pairs a logical-unit declaration with the deterministic set of `(file, span)` physical locations the resolver emits. 2.0.0 (Cut D W-07c): Layer 3-5 fields (factory, infrastructure, workflowTraceability) removed from the generic index and lifted to the OAP enricher's index-oap.json. 1.4.0 (spec 147) extended ImplementingPath with an optional `primary` boolean; 1.3.0 (spec 133) extended traceMapping with `amends` and `amendmentRecord`.

repoRoot.description: Absolute or repository-relative root used for indexing.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the deterministic input state. Used for the broad staleness check, which is a best-effort, report-only signal on `main` (spec 188 Phase 3, FR-007). The broad index carries nothing governed since Phase 4 re-homed `claudeConfigHash` to config-hash.json.

orphanedSpecs.description: Spec IDs with no implementing code.

untracedCode.description: Package paths with no governing spec.

packageRecord.description: A Rust crate or npm package.

edition.description: Rust edition (2021, 2024, etc). Null for npm packages.

entryPoints.description: Targets emitted by the manifest (e.g. lib, bin names).

internalDeps.description: Path-resolved internal dependencies (workspace neighbours, file-protocol packages).

externalDeps.description: External dependency package names (no version pins).

specRef.description: spec id declared in [package.metadata.oap].spec (Cargo) or top-level "oap.spec" (npm).

traceMapping.description: Spec-to-code mapping with sorted implementing paths.

specStatus.description: Spec lifecycle status (draft / approved / superseded / retired).

dependsOn.description: Optional list of spec ids this spec depends on.

amends.description: Spec 133 — spec ids amended by this spec via the spec 119 protocol.

amendmentRecord.description: Spec 133 — the amender spec id from the amended spec's `amendment_record:` frontmatter (reverse link).

supersedes.description: Spec 216 Phase 2b: the spec's partial-scope supersedes edges, with each predecessor id resolved to a full `NNN-slug` and each `unit:` resolved to its physical path(s). Read by the coupling gate to drop a partially-superseded predecessor from a path's authority set when a live successor supersedes it over that path. Full-scope supersession is NOT carried here (it is represented by the predecessor's `specStatus: superseded`). Omitted (empty) for the vast majority of specs.

scope.description: Always `partial` in the emitted index; full supersession is carried by `specStatus`.

paths.description: Physical path(s) the partial `unit:` resolved to.

primary.description: Spec 147 — true when this path is the primary owner of the claim per the new `implements:` list-item shape.

resolvedUnits.description: Spec 154 Segment 3 — logical-unit declarations from the spec's relationship-graph frontmatter, paired with the deterministic set of physical locations the codebase-indexer resolver emits. Defaults to empty (omitted from emission) for specs with no logical-unit-shaped declarations.

code.description: Diagnostic code. I-00x = manifest parse, I-00[3-9] (spec 154 Segment 3) = resolver hard errors, I-1xx = traceability, I-2xx = structural.

path.description: Repo-relative path related to the diagnostic.

resolvedUnit.description: Spec 154 Segment 3 — a logical-unit declaration paired with the resolver's emitted physical-location set.

unit.description: The logical-unit declaration in canonical `{ kind, ... }` shape (mirrors LogicalUnit::to_json).

kind.description: Stable kind discriminator; duplicates unit.kind for consumers that want the discriminator without re-parsing.

sourceField.description: Which relationship-graph field carried this declaration.

ownership.description: True for the seven ownership-bearing relationships; false for `references`. The coupling gate ignores non-ownership units.

locations.description: Sorted, deterministic physical locations. Empty when resolution failed and was downgraded to a diagnostic.

span.description: Optional inclusive 1-indexed line range; absent means whole-file.
